tools.name: list_formats
tools.description: List the supported statement formats, CSV column synonyms, limits and prices. Free.

tools.name: parse_statement_demo
tools.description: Free demo: parse a statement (max 24 KB) into normalized JSON; returns the first 100 transactions plus an analysis preview. Rate limited to 20 calls per hour.

tools.name: parse_statement
tools.description: Paid ($0.005): Parses a bank statement (CSV from any bank, camt.052/053/054, MT940, OFX/QFX, QIF) into normalized JSON: accounts, balances and signed transactions with ISO dates, counterparty, reference and OCR number. Deterministic, no AI, nothing stored. JSON body up to 1000 KB. Failed calls (4xx/

tools.name: analyze_statement
tools.description: Paid ($0.01): Parses a statement and adds analysis: monthly totals, top counterparties, recurring payments, suspected duplicates, largest transactions and balance reconciliation. Set include_transactions=false to receive only the analysis. JSON body up to 1000 KB. Failed calls (4xx/5xx) are not sett

tools.name: convert_statement
tools.description: Paid ($0.005): Parses a statement and exports it as normalized CSV, an hledger journal, a SIE4 file (experimental) or JSON. The converted file is returned as a string in the content field. JSON body up to 1000 KB. Failed calls (4xx/5xx) are not settled. Without a payment header the result is the x40
